cases.prompt: Add a function slugify(text) to strings.js and export it: lowercase, words joined by single hyphens, only a-z and 0-9 kept, no leading or trailing hyphens.

files.strings.js:
function capitalize(s) { return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1); }
module.exports = { capitalize };

cases.prompt: formatList in format.js joins items with commas. Add an optional second parameter { conjunction } so formatList(["a","b","c"], { conjunction: "and" }) returns "a, b and c". Without the option it must behave exactly as before.
cli.js prints a greeting. Add a --shout flag that prints it in upper case. Running node cli.js Ada should still print "Hello, Ada".
slowSquare in math.js is expensive. Add an exported memoized version, fastSquare, that calls slowSquare at most once per input.
createUser in users.js accepts anything. Make it throw an Error whose message mentions "name" when name is missing or empty, and one mentioning "age" when age is not an integer between 0 and 150.
Make config.js read settings from config.json in the project folder when it exists, falling back to the defaults for missing keys. Keep the exported loadConfig() function.
Write tests for range() in range.js in a new file range.test.js using node's assert module. They should pass when run with node range.test.js and fail if range is broken.
